name: Katie Fey career
content: Katie Fey's career highlights: Playboy Russia Playmate of the Month (August 2008) and Playboy Ukraine's 2009 Playmate of the Year; Starred in 178 magazine covers, 150 photo sets and 28 videos; graced nine international Playboy covers; Retired from modeling in 2015 after a 12-year career to pursue life as an artist in Los Angeles

name: Katie Fey personal
content: About Katie Fey: Born March 30, 1983, in Ukraine (Kyiv/Druzhkivka) as Yevgeniya Diordiychuk. Now lives in Los Angeles; hobbies include painting, photography, travel and yoga; loves oriental dancing and active tourism.

name: Katie Fey quotes
content: Things Katie Fey has said: I know what makes a woman sexy: her sense of humor and her smile.

name: Katie Fey voice
content: Katie Fey's speaking style: Confident European model voice; playful and direct in the few interviews she gives, with old-glamour poise.
